scope: Pre-execution source admission for one owned installed Modly 0.4.3 viewer-completion session, maximum 480 seconds: one normal UI master import, native camera controls, one normal UI tiny replacement, mesh selection and Delete, settled empty checkpoint. No export, neural/model execution, geometry edit, installation or production modification. GO is not an observed runtime acceptance result.
source_review: Host retains exact base/branch and twelve-file input gates, exclusive session markers, local-debug ports, process AND Job 6 GiB caps, live 12 GiB available RAM and 2 GiB destination floors, 180-second import epochs, 480-second session ceiling, watched-input identities and no forced Job-cleanup success.

startup_probe.js and renderer_observer.js are byte-identical to prior reviewed sources. Host changes are fresh mission identities/path, shorter session bound and fifth source binding; inspect_app.mjs changes only its private mission path.

Viewer discovery checks CanvasCapture canvas, Provider store, camera/control identity, event input, makeDefault controls primitive and SceneMeshModel scene.__r3f.root. Helper camera stores are rejected before wrapping rendering.

The priority-zero subscription observes actual R3F ticks without taking over rendering. Render wrapper preserves receiver, arguments, return and thrown errors, counts only successful exact-main scene/camera calls and distinguishes duplicate passes from frame ticks.

Trusted native events are correlated with changed controls pose and successful subsequent main-render CPU return. Unmatched/missed events and overhead remain reportable; this does not measure GPU/display or OS input latency.

Resource/model histories hold WeakRefs, scalar identities and dispose listeners, with deduplication and BVH presence observations. No old model/resource object is stored in telemetry; stop unsubscribes and restores its owned render wrapper/listeners.

Framing reads existing geometry boxes and matrices, reports conservative projected world AABB corners, and performs no scene/matrix/bounds writes. No cache clear, input synthesis or forced GC is present in the viewer observer.

Final additive currentModels.transform copies only model position/quaternion/scale scalar arrays. The mock uses identity TRS and asserts exact serialized values. This gives direct object-transform checkpoint evidence alongside conservative bounds.

mock_verification.final_trs_amendment: Final independent run also 6/6 PASS, 0 fail, 0 skipped. Parent recorded expected 5/6 RED then 6/6 GREEN before this review.

binding_runtime_conditions: Use only the previously proven one about:blank initialization on the existing hidden empty WebContents after reviewed bootstrap/resume. Require observer ready=true, calls=1, restored=true, no errors, original installed app URL and actual committed roots before UI. No restart, extra blank initialization, alternative startup technique or second master attempt.
Run exactly the accepted normal UI sequence. Keep bounded loading stage epochs and the existing host resource monitor active; close before the original 480-second deadline.

Human assistance for native right-drag pan is confirmed available by parent. Use that genuine native gesture when ready; if it cannot be completed, report pan BLOCKED. Do not remap controls or synthesize renderer events.
Apply predeclared orbit, pan, zoom/framing, responsiveness and cleanup thresholds to observed data and visible screenshots. Preserve missing events and failures rather than infer a PASS.

Do not directly enumerate or clear the loader cache or force GC. Report source-level useGLTF.clear separately; natural weak collection can corroborate release, and survival alone does not establish a leak.
limits: Six tests exercise pure mocked VM objects, not an actual Electron/R3F session or the real asset.
CPU submission timing is distinct from display presentation; Electron process CPU memory is not dedicated VRAM.
Shared renderer resources and retained allocators need not settle to zero. App PythonBridge shutdown behavior remains separately labelled from host-forced Job cleanup.
Preservation-before is bound as the fresh independent audit receipt; this reviewer did not rerun the full preservation audit or parse/load either GLB.
